title: public/app testing: Jest/RTL colocated + Playwright e2e in separate dir
answers: Where do unit tests vs e2e tests live for the frontend?
How do I test a redux thunk or reducer in this codebase?
body: Unit tests: Jest + React Testing Library, colocated as `*.test.ts(x)` next to source (~2100 files under `public/app/`); conventions documented in `contribute/style-guides/testing.md` and the `frontend-testing-strategy` skill. Reducers/thunks specifically should use the `reducerTester()`/`thunkTester()` helpers documented in `contribute/style-guides/redux.md` rather than hand-rolled dispatch assertions. E2E tests use Playwright, config at repo-root `playwright.config.ts`, with suites under `e2e-playwright/` organized by domain — these are NOT colocated with source, unlike unit tests.
